posts.description: I am binge-watching “ Pluribus ” this week. It is really weird, beautifully acted and shot, and I can’t stop watching it.

posts.title: Herdr
posts.description: I have been very happy with the Herdr GUI app since it was released last week. I prefer it to the Herdr TUI even though I did not expect to. (I loved the herdr TUI.) Things with Herdr are moving fast right now. Herdr replaced Ghostty for me, and, to my delight, it runs libghostty for its terminals, so it is essentially the same terminal, but multiplexed.

I found a delightful free email contact form service today: Letterbird . It offers you a free email contact form that you can link to or embed in your website so people can contact you without you publishing your email address.
